newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end lower at 21.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end lower at 21.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates fell on Monday as liquidity increased on the market in the middle of the reserve period, dealers said.
Rates ended at 21.5 percent, down on Friday's close of 22.375 percent.

"Rates are low because there's always extra liquidity in the middle of a reserve period," said Eniko Lederer of Citibank, adding that the passing of the tax payment deadline last week has also loosened up funds.
